Import several QR screenshots at once. Each image is decoded and validated, then the app walks you through them one at a time and you confirm every real payment yourself in your own banking app.
Select one or more QR screenshots. They are copied into the app, and your original gallery images are never modified.

You stay in control of every payment

QR Payment Queue copies, decodes, organizes and hands off QR payment information. It never enters PINs or OTPs, never touches biometric prompts or bank security screens, and never marks a payment as paid on its own.
Queue states: DISCOVERED → DECODED → VALIDATED → READY → SUBMITTED → WAITING_CONFIRMATION → SUCCESS → RECONCILED / PAID
